text_en: To the leader: according to Jeduthun. A Psalm of David.
text_cn: 达味诗歌，交与乐官耶杜通。

text_en: For God alone my soul waits in silence; from him comes my salvation.
text_cn: 我的灵魂只安息在天主内， 因为我的救援是由他而来。

text_en: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress; I shall never be shaken.
text_cn: 只有他是我的磐石，我的救星； 他是我的堡垒，我决不致摇倾。

text_en: How long will you assail a person, will you batter your victim, all of you, as you would a leaning wall, a tottering fence?
text_cn: 你们不断侵犯一人，并向他一人冲击， 如冲击将倒的墙，将坍的壁，要到几时？

text_en: Their only plan is to bring down a person of prominence. They take pleasure in falsehood; they bless with their mouths, but inwardly they curse. Selah
text_cn: 实在，他们企图，要将我由我高位上推下； 他们喜爱谎言，口虽祝福，心却辱骂。 (休止)

text_en: For God alone my soul waits in silence, for my hope is from him.
text_cn: 我的灵魂，你只安息在天主内， 因为我的期望全是由他而来。

text_en: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress; I shall not be shaken.
text_cn: 只有他是我的磐石，我的救星； 他是我的堡垒，我决不致摇倾。

text_en: On God rests my deliverance and my honor; my mighty rock, my refuge is in God.
text_cn: 我的救恩，我的光荣全在于天主， 我的堡垒，我的护卫全基于天主。

text_en: Trust in him at all times, O people; pour out your heart before him; God is a refuge for us. Selah
text_cn: 百姓，你们该常向他表示依靠， 该在他面前吐露你们的心窍： 因为天主确是我们的避难所。 （休止）

text_en: Those of low estate are but a breath, those of high estate are a delusion; in the balances they go up; they are together lighter than a breath.
text_cn: 庶民不过是口气，显贵也无非是幻影； 放在天秤上必然浮起，合计还比气轻。

text_en: Put no confidence in extortion, and set no vain hopes on robbery; if riches increase, do not set your heart on them.
text_cn: 莫依势凌人，不要以劫掠骄矜； 如财宝日增，也不要挂念在心。

text_en: Once God has spoken; twice have I heard this: that power belongs to God,
text_cn: 天主说过一次，我确实也听过两次：

text_en: and steadfast love belongs to you, O Lord. For you repay to all according to their work.
text_cn: “威能属于天主；我主，慈爱也非你莫属， 因你按照各人的行为，予各人以报酬。”
